must_do: A.4: derive the expected loadable-artifact extension from :os.type/0 via the mapping table in A.4 step 1 (encode as a case/map, not left as prose) -- fail loudly on an unmapped OS, do not silently skip.

A.4 step 2/3: assert the fixed-name artifact exists for the derived extension; if absent, fall back to a directory listing of priv/native asserting at least one entry has the expected extension, with a failure message distinguishing which branch fired.

A.5: branch on whether :external_resource is empty. Non-empty branch asserts AT LEAST ONE entry ends in '.rs' (Enum.any?/2 + String.ends_with?/2) -- do NOT assert every entry ends in .rs, that is empirically false against the real vendored deps/wasmex/native/wasmex/ tree under this project's WASMEX_BUILD=true build path. Empty branch asserts the A.4-step-3 fallback invariant holds instead of failing.
A.6: do not wrap either assertion in an :os.type()-guarded skip/tag-exclude for non-Unix hosts -- this is an explicit non-goal and will be rejected by REVIEWER/CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR if seen.

A.7 (OQ-A1): empirically verify via a one-line mix run -e check whether :external_resource is actually empty or non-empty on this repo's real CI/dev build (WASMEX_BUILD=true), and record which of A.5's two branches actually fires -- do not assume.

Part B: give each test-partition process its own MIX_BUILD_PATH via a hardlink-preserving copy of the already-compiled _build/test tree, seeded sequentially and fully before any partition is backgrounded, per B.2-B.4. No Windows-detect-and-retry shortcut (B.3's Approach 1 is explicitly rejected in the design).
